hypotheses.reasoning: At 16:33:03 a geo-cache node was replaced and the cache restarted with 0 keys because no RDB snapshot was found (#109). Seconds later ingest-api reported a 92–95% cache miss ratio against a 5% baseline and started loading the misses from events-db (#114, #117). events-db then hit 490/500 connections and 98% CPU (#113), point lookups slowed to about 6s (#126, #130), and ingest-api queries timed out after 5000ms (#131, #142). Those timeouts surfaced as the 504s at ingest-gateway. The empty cache alone would have been survivable; the damage came from every miss hitting the database.
Reading the slow events-db queries as the root cause. But the database only slowed down after the cache was emptied, so it looks like a symptom.

verdict.recommendedAction: Warm geo-cache from events-db with rate limiting. In ingest-api, add request coalescing / single-flight on cache misses and a cap on concurrent DB loads. Turn on RDB/AOF persistence so a replaced cache node doesn't come back empty.
